evidence.snippet: Our Hobby plan is free and a great way to get started
You can raise many of the limits on this page. The process depends on your plan

decisions.reason: The Hobby plan is free and self-serve, and the REST API/account tokens are available on Hobby accounts (webhooks and other advanced features being Pro/Enterprise-gated doesn't block basic API access on the free tier).
The pages reference an official 'Vercel MCP' tool set but no URL for a vendor-published MCP server repository is given, and the claimed next-devtools-mcp URL is not present on any provided page.
